about.title: About Emeraude Africa
about.subtitle: Democratizing real estate investment in Africa, for everyone.
about.missionDesc: Emeraude Africa was born from a strong conviction: Africa's urban and economic development must benefit those who believe in it. We designed this platform to allow the diaspora and local residents to easily invest in profitable and secure real estate projects, starting from accessible amounts (from 10,000 FCFA or equivalent).
about.transparencyDesc: We independently audit each project. You have access to all financial and legal information before investing.
about.securityDesc: Your funds are secured through our approved banking partners. We operate in strict compliance with current regulations.
about.teamDesc: A team of passionate tech and real estate experts, uniting the best PropTech practices with the realities of African markets.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Have questions? We have answers.
faq.a1: Emeraude Africa is a crowdfunding platform specializing in African real estate. We allow individuals to invest in pre-selected real estate projects starting from just 10,000 FCFA (or equivalent).
faq.a2: Each project submitted by a developer goes through a strict audit committee that verifies financial viability, legal compliance (land titles, permits), and the developer's track record.
faq.a3: Like any real estate investment, there is a risk of capital loss or illiquidity. However, all our projects are backed by real assets (real estate properties), which significantly limits the risks.
faq.q4: How can I withdraw my earnings?
faq.a4: Revenues generated by rent or resale are paid directly into your Emeraude investor space. You can then reinvest them or transfer them to your bank account or Mobile Money.
faq.notFoundDesc: Our support team is here to help you with your inquiries.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions of Use and Sale
terms.subtitle: Rules for using the platform and the legal framework for investments.

sections.title: 1. Purpose
paragraphs: These Terms and Conditions govern access to and use of the Emeraude Africa real estate crowdfunding platform. By using our services, you accept these Terms and Conditions without reservation.

sections.title: 2. Access to services
paragraphs: Access to investment projects requires creating a user account and providing valid identity documents (KYC - Know Your Customer process), in accordance with anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing legislation (AML-CFT). An investment can only be made once your identity has been verified by our team. A project owner cannot invest in their own project.

sections.title: 3. Payments and protection of funds
paragraphs: Online payments are processed by licensed providers: CinetPay, Wave, PayDunya and Flutterwave (Mobile Money, e-wallets and cards), and Stripe (international cards). Depending on the payment method chosen, the platform automatically selects an available provider; investors may also indicate a preferred provider. A bank or manual money transfer is also possible: the investment is then validated by our team once the funds are received.

An investment is only validated after the payment has been confirmed directly with the provider, for an amount and currency identical to those of the subscription. A payment not completed within 24 hours expires and the corresponding investment is cancelled, free of charge. The minimum subscription amount is the one shown on each project page, up to the amount still to be raised.

Before each investment, the investor expressly accepts these terms and the risk warning; the date of this acceptance is recorded. Invested funds are held in a dedicated account until the fundraising closes. If the fundraising target is not reached or the project is cancelled, investors are refunded in full at no additional cost. A payment received twice is refunded.

sections.title: 4. Risk warning
paragraphs: Real estate investment and crowdfunding carry inherent risks:
items: Risk of capital loss: you may lose all or part of the funds invested.
Illiquidity risk: investments are locked in for the duration of the project (generally 12 to 36 months). It is very difficult, or even impossible, to sell your shares before maturity.
after: We advise you never to invest money you may need in the short term and to diversify your investments.

sections.title: 5. Intellectual property
paragraphs: All content on the platform (texts, images, logos, architecture) is protected by copyright. Any unauthorised reproduction is strictly prohibited.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.subtitle: Protecting your personal data and respecting your privacy.

sections.title: 1. Data collected
paragraphs: When you sign up, invest and contact us, Emeraude Africa collects the following data:
items: Identification data: last name, first name, email address, phone number.

Legal documents (ID document, proof of address) as part of our verification obligations (KYC). They are stored with restricted access and can only be viewed by our compliance team, through temporary links.

Transaction data: investment history, chosen payment method, provider used, payment references and statuses, and a time-stamped log of exchanges with that provider (traceability and fraud prevention). We never store your card numbers or Mobile Money codes: they are entered directly with our payment providers (CinetPay, Wave, PayDunya, Flutterwave, Stripe).
Proof of consent: date and time you accepted these terms when signing up, and the Terms and Conditions of Sale before each investment.
Contact form and newsletter: name, email address, phone (optional), message content, page of origin and date of your consent.
Audience measurement: pages viewed and technical information about your browser, only if you accepted it in the cookie banner.

sections.title: 2. Purposes of processing
paragraphs: Your data is used exclusively to:
items: Manage your account and investments.
Generate your legal and tax certificates.
Answer your requests and, if you agreed, send you our newsletter.
Improve the site with traffic statistics, if you agreed.
Comply with legal obligations (fraud and money laundering prevention).

sections.title: 3. Data sharing
paragraphs: Your personal information is never sold to third parties for commercial purposes. It may only be shared with the competent authorities in the event of a legal requisition, and with the payment provider used for your transaction (CinetPay, Wave, PayDunya, Flutterwave or Stripe): last name, first name, email address, phone, amount and transaction reference, only to the extent necessary to process it. Our technical subcontractors (hosting, email delivery, file storage, audience measurement) only access it to provide their service. Some of these providers may process data outside your country of residence, with security safeguards consistent with their regulatory obligations.

sections.title: 4. Retention period
paragraphs: In accordance with financial regulations, account and transaction data is kept for the entire duration of the business relationship, then archived for 5 years for traceability and evidence purposes. Contact requests are kept for 3 years after the last exchange. Newsletter subscriptions are kept until you unsubscribe. Your cookie choice is kept for 6 months.

sections.title: 5. Cookies
paragraphs: The site uses storage strictly necessary for it to work (keeping you signed in). Audience measurement cookies are only set after your consent; you can change your choice at any time via the "Manage cookies" link at the bottom of the page.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
paragraphs: Under data protection laws (in particular Senegalese law no. 2008-12 and the GDPR for European residents), you have the right to access, rectify, erase, object to and port your data, and the right to withdraw your consent at any time. To exercise these rights, contact: privacy@emeraude-africa.com.
